title: Range add, range minimum
statement: An array of n zeros. Operations: [0, l, r, v] adds v to every element in [l, r]; [1, l, r] asks for the minimum on [l, r]. Return the answers to the queries in order.
hints: A Fenwick tree can't do range-min; a segment tree can.
Range updates: store a pending add at a node that's fully covered instead of pushing it to every leaf.

solution.explanation: Segment tree: each node covers a range and stores its minimum. A lazy tag at a fully-covered node records "add v to my whole range" without visiting the children; here the tag is folded in on the way back up (non-propagating lazy), which works because adding commutes with min. Every operation touches O(log n) nodes. Any associative combine (sum, min, max, gcd) fits this template.
